    do
        yield current

        let said = System.Text.StringBuilder()
        let i mut = 0

        while i < current.length do
            let digit = current[i]
            let run mut = 0

            while i < current.length /\ current[i] == digit do

                i = i + 1
            od

            said.append(run)
            said.append(digit)
